title: 2017 Bowman Chrome Refractor Wuilmer Becerra New York Mets Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This Wuilmer Becerra 2017 Bowman Chrome Prospect Refractor card is a must-have for any New York Mets fan or baseball card collector. The card features a stunning chrome refractor design that is sure to catch the eye of anyone who sees it. 

With aspects like Major League (MLB) and Sports Trading Card, this card is a valuable addition to any collection. The 2017 Bowman Chrome set is known for its high-quality cards, and this one is no exception. Manufactured by Bowman, this card is a great representation of Wuilmer Becerra, a talented player for the New York Mets. Add this card to your collection today!
